```
WITH merchant_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        merchant_id, 
        merchant_name, 
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, 
        AVG(amount) AS average_amount
    FROM 
        transactions
    GROUP BY 
        merchant_id, 
        merchant_name
),
average_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(average_amount) AS overall_avg_amount, 
        STDDEV(average_amount) AS overall_stddev_amount
    FROM 
        merchant_stats
)
SELECT 
    ms.merchant_name, 
    ms.transaction_count, 
    ms.average_amount
FROM 
    merchant_stats ms, 
    average_stats as
WHERE 
    ms.transaction_count > (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) FROM merchant_stats) * 2 -- High transaction volume
    AND (ms.average_amount > as.overall_avg_amount + 2 * as.overall_stddev_amount -- Very high average amount
    OR ms.average_amount < as.overall_avg_amount - 2 * as.overall_stddev_amount) -- Very low average amount
ORDER BY 
    ms.transaction_count DESC, 
    ABS(ms.average_amount - as.overall_avg_amount) DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

Note: This query is based on assumptions about the database schema and may need adjustments based on the actual schema.
